hook: Stop digging for paint cans — $24.99 fixed it

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand reaching behind a row of items on a garage shelf, straining to grab something in the back
scenes.voiceover: This was every trip to the garage shelf.

scenes.visual_prompt: A can gets knocked over and rolls off the shelf as the hand keeps digging
scenes.voiceover: Paint cans always end up in the back.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unpacking a 4-pack of 10-inch non-skid lazy Susan turntables
scenes.voiceover: 4.7 stars across 6,190 reviews — that's not a fluke.

scenes.visual_prompt: Loading a turntable with paint cans and spray bottles, then spinning it to bring items forward
scenes.on_screen_text: One spin brings it all forward
scenes.voiceover: No more reaching, no more knocking things over.

scenes.visual_prompt: Testing the non-skid base by tilting the shelf slightly — the turntable stays put
scenes.voiceover: Even on a shelf that isn't perfectly level.

scenes.visual_prompt: Four turntables on the shelf, each holding a different category: paint, automotive fluids, hardware, cleaning supplies
Text card over the finished garage wall shot
scenes.on_screen_text: Part of my $91 garage wall system.
scenes.voiceover: Full build on the blog, link in bio.

caption: $24.99 fixed the one garage annoyance I'd been ignoring for years — digging behind stuff for the one can I actually needed. Full system breakdown on the blog.
